content: There are not enough funds in the portal wallet. Contact your Payer to top it up

comment.text: Description under the AI paused title in the warning bar above the AI chat input, shown to users who cannot top up the portal wallet themselves; Payer is the portal role that pays for the portal and keeps its capital letter as a role name.

usage.context:
<AINotice
 title={t("Common:AIPaused")}
 description={
 isPayer
 ? t("Common:AIPausedWalletEmpty")
 : t("Common:AIPausedWalletEmptyContactPayer")
 }
 buttonLabel={t("Common:TopUpWallet")}
 onClick={isPayer ? openPage(PAYMENT_ROUTES.wallet) : undefined}
 dataTestId="metadata_ai_wallet_notice"
 buttonTestId="metadata_ai_top_up_button"
